metadata.title: Shopify Stock Plunges. Slowing Merchandise Sales Flash a Warning Sign.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Shopify Stock Plunges. Slowing Merchandise Sales Flash a Warning Sign.
Shopify stock took a hit after the e-commerce company reported weaker-than-expected merchandise sales in the third quarter, raising questions about the sustainability of its rapid growth even as earnings and profitability improved.
